en: You should have no secret from one of{SAUT}His messengers!(*RESPONSE*)

en: What a troublesome human... The Lord{SAUT}watches over you, even if you do not{SAUT}carry out such bizarre acts.(*RESPONSE*)

en: So that is why...(*RESPONSE*)

en: I refer to you! You!(*RESPONSE*)

en: May His blessing be with you...(*RESPONSE*)

en: ＊gasp＊ So it was a trap! Deceiving an{SAUT}angel is an act of blasphemy towards Him!(*RESPONSE*)

en: You are rash, yet surprisingly honest.(*RESPONSE*)

en: I only wanted a little, you see...(*RESPONSE*)

en: Ahaha... It was a mere jest.(*RESPONSE*)
